title: Environmental Hazards and Corruption (lasers, vents, debris, yellow zones)
description:
Purpose: Implement hazards: asteroid debris impacts, mining lasers (reflectable), decompression vents, and yellow-energy suppression zones. Barriers and domes mitigate hazards; repairs restore safety. In yellow zones, sustained costs increase and control constructs may fail faster.

Behaviour:
- Mining Lasers: beam volumes that can be redirected via Barrier Wall reflection normals; powering nodes updates objectives (satisfies test_environmental_laser_reflection).
- Decompression Vents: periodic suction toward breaches; hover/platform traversal recommended; fail volumes trigger checkpoint respawn.
- Asteroid Debris: spawners for moving hazards with telegraphs.
- Yellow Zones: volumes that increase ring drain multiplier (e.g., +50%) and reduce control effectiveness (increase tether break chance). HUD shows amber suppression indicator.

Components:
- Reads: construct presence (barrier, dome), player location, mission objectives.
- Writes: hazard events, ring drain multiplier requests to promoted.ring_charge_and_recharge, HUD suppression indicators.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_derelict_breach_navigation, test_fear_zone_drain_penalty.

Integration and depends_on:
- Depends on mission_system for objective updates.
- Interacts with control_constructs_extension and defense constructs from core.

Scenes:
- asteroid_mining_outpost, derelict_space_station, fear_corrupted_ruins.

Suggested file split: hazards_register.cpp, hazards_lasers.cpp, hazards_vents.cpp, hazards_debris.cpp, hazards_yellow_zones.cpp.
